data.corrects_the_sweep: P11 recorded that the converse quantity 'has no name'. It has a name - alpha, P(verifier rejects | artefact is good) - and it is the other factor in the closed form the architecture turns on: beta* = (1-alpha)*exp(-k*gap). It appears in ADR-0002's update and falsifiability paragraph, ADR-0026's consequences, and twice in v0-draft as an axis of the (delta, alpha, beta, rho) surface.
data.the_defect: alpha is named, modelled and load-bearing, and its only value anywhere in the repository is 0.03, invented in simulations.py and repeated in findings.md. No denominator in beta.py, no consumer in projection.py, no line in EXP-01's Measures, no register entry, no Q-number.
data.effect_on_beta_star: scale factor exactly (1-0.327)/(1-0.03) = 0.6938 at every gap, because beta* is linear in (1-alpha). At gap 0.27 beta* moves from 0.1119 to 0.0776. Every threshold may be roughly 31% tighter than the documents assume, and the error runs in the optimistic direction.
data.the_caveat_that_is_not_optional: 0.327 is NOT alpha and must not be quoted as alpha. It is red-merged over merged, selected on the merge decision, and uses 'the human merged it' as proxy for 'the artefact is good' - carrying beta's joint-error caveat plus a selection bias beta does not have. It establishes that the assumption is wrong and which way; it does not establish the replacement.
data.why_it_is_cheap: alpha and beta are the two off-diagonal cells of one 2x2 table and their denominators partition the labelled set. alpha does not need its own verdicts, it needs the ones beta discards - and projection.py already stores both columns, so alpha is a SELECT over data the observe-only increment already records. The scarcity inverts too: MIN_REJECTIONS wants 30 human rejections, alpha wants 30 human accepts, and on any corpus mined from merges the accepts dominate. Alpha is measurable today on the corpus where beta is not.

data.timeout_fix: subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=T) kills the direct child then blocks in communicate() draining pipes the surviving grandchildren hold open, so TimeoutExpired is not raised until they exit on their own. run_attempt now uses Popen, kills the whole tree via taskkill /T /F on Windows or killpg elsewhere, then drains with a bounded second communicate.

data.what_it_says_about_ADR_0034: the ADR chose artefact progress over PID liveness because PIDs recycle and zombies hold pipes. This is the cost on the other side and the ADR does not name it. The fix is not to go back to PIDs: a monitor must read the terminal state the work writes for itself - here complete and stop_reason, both present in the results file and both saying the run had ended under its cap. The heartbeat read the file's size and ignored its contents.
data.action: stopped, rather than left to repeat a false statement ten more times into the maintainer's morning. Same reasoning as the replay check: a signal that reports a state it did not verify is worse than no signal, because it is read as verification.
data.near_miss_in_the_same_breath: the check-in showed VRAM going 29436 -> 3489 and I read it as something now holding 26 GB, and went looking for what to free. It is the opposite: the heartbeat reports USED VRAM, so a falling number means the model unloaded. nvidia-smi confirms 3489 used against 28699 free at 1% utilisation. I checked before acting, which is the only reason this is a postscript rather than another incident - and a monitor that does not label its units invites exactly this. Mine did not label them.
